description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Rubber Wire Harness Grommets for the Headlights & Blinkers.
Prevents Abrasion to Wires that Cause Fires and Electrical Shorts.
These protect the Wiring Harness as it Passes Through the Metal Panel that Separates the Engine from the Headlight Area.
If these are Missing on you Samurai then you Really Need to Buy These
Easy to Install. Installs in just a couple of Seconds!
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Wire Grommets
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
